portion.allclear: Every file in every queue is under the Bot API's limits, every comic has postable pages, and nothing inside them is pretending to be a picture.
portion.description: Walks every queue for what the bot will fail on before it fails at three in the morning: too big, comics with nothing postable inside, pages that are not pictures. Shrinks what can be shrunk.
portion.empty: Weighing every queue. Comics are opened to look at their pages, so this takes a moment.
portion.error.nobot: Could not find the posting bot. Pick its folder.
portion.hold.note: Moves it out of the queue into the group's Held_Back folder, beside To_Send, where the bot never looks. Nothing is deleted.
portion.howitworks: Photos over 10 MB, or wider plus taller than 10000 pixels, and anything else over 50 MB, fail at the moment the bot sends them. Shrinking never happens in place: the new file is written beside the original, checked to be smaller and to decode, and only then does the original go to the Recycle Bin. The modified time is kept, so the file stays where it was in the queue.
portion.list: WILL NOT POST, OR NOT AS EXPECTED
portion.notify.found: Portion found files the bot will fail on
portion.outcome.done: Shrunk from {0} to {1}. The original is in the Recycle Bin.
portion.remedy.badpages: A page whose bytes are not a picture fails the whole batch it is in. Open the archive and replace or remove it; Portion will not guess which.
portion.remedy.comic: The heavy pages will be made smaller and the archive rebuilt around them, same names, same order, so the bot's resume state still applies.
portion.remedy.comic.note: Nothing here stops it posting. Files the bot skips are left where they are, and a long comic simply takes several posts.
portion.remedy.document: A document over the limit has to be split or compressed by hand; there is no honest way to shrink a PDF without knowing what is in it.
portion.remedy.empty: There is nothing in this archive the bot can send. Open it and see what it was meant to be; Kibble can rebuild it from the loose pages.
portion.remedy.photo: The picture will be brought under the limit, easing the quality first and shrinking it only if that is not enough. The original goes to the Recycle Bin.
portion.remedy.ratio: Scaling does not change a picture's shape. This one needs cropping, which is a decision rather than a conversion, so it is left to you.
portion.remedy.video: A video needs re-encoding, which is ffmpeg's job rather than this plugin's. Bring it under 50 MB and it will go.
portion.shrinkall.hint: Every picture and comic in the list. Videos and documents stay as they are.
portion.status.clear: Nothing in any queue will fail to post.
